A.session_notes: BACK REWORK. Cable Crunch is out, Hanging Knee Raise is in (slot 5). Cue: curl your PELVIS up toward your ribs, do not just lift the knees. Lower back rounding slightly at the top is correct here. If you only lift the knees it becomes a hip flexor exercise, which is the opposite of what we want. Bench cut to 3 sets at 70 - two sessions at RPE 10 with no progress is a volume problem. Add a 4th set only if set 3 comes in at RPE 8. Cable Wrist Curl target is 25: you logged 25 twice against a plan of 60, please confirm which is right.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press
exercises.notes: 3 sets, not 4. Add a 4th only if set 3 is RPE 8 or easier.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Hold. No RPE logged last time.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45
exercises.notes: Hold 145. Partial ROM. Stop before your pelvis tucks off the pad at the bottom.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Same weight, 12 reps instead of 10.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.notes: NEW - replaces Cable Crunch. Hang from the pull-up bar. Curl the pelvis up toward the ribs, not just the knees. Hanging also puts the spine in traction instead of compression. If grip fails before the abs do, use the captain's chair.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Curl (superset A)
exercises.notes: Straight into the wrist curl, no rest.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl (superset B)
exercises.notes: CONFIRM THIS NUMBER. Plan said 60, you logged 25 on 08-09 and 08-17.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly (drop set)
exercises.notes: One triple drop, no rest between drops. 47.5 to failure, drop ~25%, to failure, drop, to failure.

B.session_notes: THE BACK DAY - biggest changes here. RDL is PARKED for 3-4 weeks after the 08-21 pinch, replaced by Hip Thrust. Cable Crunch is replaced by Suitcase Carry, which your profile says helped your back before and which has not been in the program since. Pull-ups down to 3 sets - that is where the pinch happened, so stop instantly on any catch. Both hip thrust and carry are new: the weights below are starting guesses, log what you actually do and they will be right next time. Do NOT put load back on the hinge until one full Day B passes symptom-free.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: NEW - replaces RDL. Shoulder blades on a bench, chin tucked, squeeze glutes and stop at NEUTRAL. Do not arch past straight at the top. This is the loadable version of the reverse hyper you said helps you. 50 kg is a form-finding load, go heavier next time if it is easy.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip
exercises.notes: 3 sets, not 4. This is where the back pinched on 08-21. Stop the set and the exercise on any catch.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: Hold 22.5. Gained here on 08-11, then not logged on 08-21.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: Hold. Skipped on 08-21.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Hold 40. Skipped on 08-21.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: NEW - replaces Cable Crunch. One dumbbell, one hand, walk 40 m, swap hands, walk 40 m back. Stand tall, do not lean away from the weight, ribs down. This is anti-lateral-flexion work under load. Go heavier if 24 feels easy.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: One triple drop, no rest between drops.

C.session_notes: SUGGESTED NEXT - Day C is the stalest at 7 days. Unchanged structurally, and this is your free-progress day: four adds are earned from the 08-16 numbers. Box squat and lat pulldown both came in at RPE 7 with all reps, so those two go up with high confidence. Cable row and hammer curl go up with medium confidence - if either feels like RPE 9+, drop back and hold. Watch the clock: last Day C was 81 min against a 50-min target, so keep the rests honest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: Same weight, 12 reps instead of 10.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.notes: ADD 2.5. Was 52.5 at RPE 7 with all reps. Controlled depth, knee-safe.

exercises.name: Cable Row
exercises.notes: ADD 2.5. Was 50 at RPE 8. Keep the torso still, do not row with your lower back.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Hold. Came in at RPE 10 on 08-16. Bonus: the rear leg gets a loaded hip flexor stretch, which is on-theme for the tilt.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: ADD 5. Was 40 at RPE 7, down from RPE 10 - the effort collapsed, so take the jump.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: ADD 2.5. Was 12.5 at RPE 7.

exercises.name: Lying Incline Dumbbell Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: Hold 10. Bench at 45-60 deg, upper arms hanging behind the torso and still.
